guestBioOfficial.en: Mike Krieger is the chief product officer of Anthropic and the co-founder of Instagram. After leaving Meta, he co-founded Artifact, an AI-powered news app that I absolutely loved, and joined Anthropic to lead product in 2024. *In this episode, you'll learn:*
guestBioOfficial.zh: 迈克·克里格（Mike Krieger）是Anthropic的首席产品官，也是Instagram的联合创始人。离开Meta后，他联合创立了由人工智能驱动的新闻应用Artifact（我对这款应用赞不绝口），并于2024年加入Anthropic负责产品管理。*在本期节目中，您将学习到：*

title.en: Anthropic's CPO on what comes next | Mike Krieger (co-founder of Instagram)
title.zh: Anthropic公司的首席产品官谈未来发展 | 迈克·克里格（Instagram联合创始人）

summary.en: Mike reveals that over half - now ~70% - of Anthropic's pull requests are generated by Claude Code, forcing a re-architecture of their merge queue. He describes the Claude Code team building Claude Code in a self-improving loop as the most futuristic way of working. The episode offers a front-row view of product-building inside a leading AI lab.
summary.zh: 迈克透露，Anthropic 超过一半（如今约 70%）的合并请求由 Claude Code 生成，迫使他们重新架构合并队列。他描述 Claude Code 团队用 Claude Code 自我迭代地构建自身，是"最具未来感"的工作方式。本期让人近距离看到领先 AI 实验室内部的产品构建。
